headline: Siemens IoT2050 flaw exploited to plant backdoors; Synology NAS hit by ransomware; Harvard breach exposes about 851,000 accounts

bullets.text: New: The Hacker News reports attackers are exploiting a critical Siemens IoT2050 flaw, CVE-2026-58115, to plant remote command backdoors.

New: The Hacker News reports ransomware attacks on Synology NAS devices exploiting a patched DSM flaw. It also reports attackers targeting an unpatched CryptoPayment Gateway flaw, CVE-2026-81648, that can expose wallet credentials.

New: BleepingComputer reports the Harvard University breach exposed information on 851,000 accounts; Have I Been Pwned added 850,537. The Hacker News reports a new wave of refrigeration cyberattacks on European supermarkets, forcing stores to pull food.
Binance, 7 outlets: The Register reports the FBI pins the $6.3B heist on North Korean hackers; SecurityWeek says the FBI flagged over 600 addresses.

Connect Secure, 4 outlets: Ivanti patched two more zero-days chained in attacks, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527. CISA KEV lists CVE-2026-104935 in the same product, with federal due dates of 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-13.
BleepingComputer reports over 1,000 GitLab servers are vulnerable to ongoing RCE attacks. CISA KEV lists GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229, whose federal due date passed on 2026-11-01.

actions: Find Siemens IoT2050 devices, check Siemens guidance on CVE-2026-58115, patch, and look for backdoors. Isolate any you cannot patch yet.
Update DSM on Synology NAS devices, restrict their internet exposure, and confirm backups are intact.
Patch GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) and Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418) now; both KEV due dates have passed. Check GitLab servers for signs of RCE.
Apply Ivanti's latest Connect Secure patches, covering CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, and check appliances for compromise.
If you run CryptoPayment Gateway, restrict access until CVE-2026-81648 is fixed and rotate wallet credentials if you suspect exposure.
If you handle crypto transactions, screen against the addresses the FBI flagged for the Binance heist, and warn staff about Binance-themed scams.
